summary.what_it_is: T3 Code is a control surface that lets you manage AI coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Grok Build, OpenCode, Google Antigravity, fx) from a mobile app, web app, or desktop app. It runs a local server on your machine and connects to the agents you already have installed and authenticated.
summary.why_trending: The project gained over 13,000 stars in a single week while still in early development. It addresses a hot topic — unified remote control for multiple AI coding assistants — with polished native apps for iOS, Android, and desktop.
summary.who_its_for: Developers who use one or more AI coding assistants and want a single remote interface to control them from a phone or another machine.
